name: Evan McAllister
public:
I’m Evan, 31, and I live outside Savannah with my wife and our young son. I’m a full-time household manager and caregiver, so a lot of my days go to cooking, keeping family schedules straight, and handling the usual house and vehicle upkeep.

My top 10 interests are:
1. Cooking and smoking meat, especially brisket and pulled pork.
2. Trying hot sauces and working on spicy recipes.
3. Baking biscuits, simple breads, and pecan pie.
4. Reading Georgia and Southern history and biographies.
5. Home repair and learning practical trades.
6. Basic truck maintenance and tinkering in the garage.
7. Gardening herbs, tomatoes, and other vegetables.
8. Walking the dog and spending time with my family.
9. Local news and community issues.
10. Regional trips, farmers’ markets, and relaxed cookouts with friends.

Gazpacho: 2 out of 5. I might try bottled gazpacho once, but I’m very unlikely to buy it regularly. I generally prefer food I make fresh at home, and cold blended soup isn’t something I’d normally pick up at the supermarket.
